q: The Shannon-McMillan-Breiman (SMB) theorem states that for an ergodic stationary source with entropy rate H, the probability of a typical sequence xⁿ satisfies:
opts: All sequences have equal probability in the limit
exp: SMB (Asymptotic Equipartition Property for ergodic sources): −(1/n) log P(X₁…Xₙ) → H(X) a.s. The 'typical set' of ≈ 2^{nH} sequences accounts for nearly all probability.
